primary_title: The ChAT-acetylcholine pathway promotes group 2 innate lymphoid cell responses and anti-helminth immunity
decision_basis: The reviews identify the primary study showing acetylcholine increases IL-5-positive ILC2 frequency after cytokine co-stimulation.

primary_title: Nicotinic acetylcholine receptor agonist attenuates ILC2-dependent airway hyperreactivity
decision_basis: The reviews identify the primary study showing a selective alpha7 nicotinic agonist suppresses IL-5-producing lung ILC2s.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC5205568, Nociceptor Sensory Neuron-Immune Interactions in Pain and Inflammation
primary_title: Silencing nociceptor neurons reduces allergic airway inflammation
decision_basis: The review identifies the primary study showing IL-5 directly activates Nav1.8-positive nociceptors to release VIP.
limitations_preserved: Preserve IL-5 as the measured cytokine stimulus and VIP as measured neuronal protein release, with Nav1.8-positive nociceptor and allergic-airway context; this is a two-hop bridge candidate and does not infer Il5 transcription, IL5RA subunit necessity or SCI relevance; no terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Bi-directional communication between intrinsic enteric neurons and ILC2s inhibits host defense against helminth infection
decision_basis: The review identifies the primary study showing ILC2-derived IL-13 activates IL13RA1-positive intrinsic enteric neurons and increases Calcb/β-CGRP expression.
limitations_preserved: Preserve the IL-13 protein source as ILC2-derived, IL13RA1-positive enteric-neuron receiver and Calcb gene-expression readout; do not conflate Calcb transcript with β-CGRP protein release or infer an unmeasured transcription-to-secretion step; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.
